2609.00749.title: ContextPipe: Database-Inspired Context Assembly for Long-Horizon Agents
2609.00749.paper_summary: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents require context assembly: the runtime must decide what to include in each prompt, in what order, and when to compact history under a hard context-window budget and a byte-sensitive prompt cache. In production agentic systems, this logic is scattered across prompt builders, ad hoc compaction routines, cache-break workarounds, and per-provider shims. We argue that context assembly is structurally isomorphic to query execution in a relational database: both execute under a hard budget, exploit a tiered cache, and leverage statistics. We adopt this discipline in ContextPipe: a five-phase pipeline (Plan Bind Optimize Execute Feedback) backed by a structured data-source catalog, a deterministic cache-aware optimizer, and an EXPLAIN ANALYZE trace. We show that context in ContextPipe is auditable, replayable, and failure-isolated. A preliminary evaluation using the SWE-bench Pro Qutebrowser subset shows that, compared with the append-only context construction policy, ContextPipe reduces total token volume by 31%, LLM calls by 23%, and response time by 9%, at the cost of a lower KV cache-hit ratio.
2609.00749.paper_summary_zh: 長期視野的大型語言模型 (LLM) 代理需要上下文組裝：運行時必須決定在每個提示中包含什麼、順序如何，以及何時在硬性上下文窗口預算和對字節敏感的提示緩存下壓縮歷史。在生產代理系統中，這種邏輯分散在提示生成器、臨時壓縮例程、緩存破壞的變通方法以及每個提供者的適配器中。我們主張，上下文組裝在結構上與關聯數據庫中的查詢執行同構：兩者都在硬性預算下執行，利用分層緩存，並利用統計數據。我們在 ContextPipe 中採用了這一學科：一個五階段的管道（計劃、綁定、優化、執行、反饋），由結構化數據源目錄、確定性的緩存感知優化器和 EXPLAIN ANALYZE 跟蹤支持。我們展示了 ContextPipe 中的上下文是可審計的、可重播的，並且具有故障隔離性。使用 SWE-bench Pro Qutebrowser 子集的初步評估顯示，與僅附加上下文構建策略相比，ContextPipe 將總標記量減少了 31%、LLM 調用減少了 23%、響應時間減少了 9%，代價是較低的 KV 緩存命中率。
